fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) stock price has risen over 1,200% over the past five years but has declined more than 25% from its recent peak, with a valuation exceeding $1 trillion in market cap.
fields.summary_ko.1: Annual operating income of $9.9B against revenue of $13.3B represents a 75% margin, but historically being a cyclical business suggests long-term sustainability is unlikely.
